Tech Mahindra Limited has informed the Exchange that Record date for the purpose of Dividend is 23-Oct-2026.

Tech Mahindra Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated October 15, 2026, titled "Press Release on the financial results".

Tech Mahindra Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on October 15, 2026, declared Interim Dividend of Rs. 15 per equity share.
Tech Mahindra Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
